About this page

This page was auto-generated by the WanderWise diff tracker. It compares two dated snapshots of our verified visa dataset and publishes every meaningful change. Status flips (e.g. visa-required → e-visa) and day-limit changes usually reflect real policy updates. New pairs and source URL updates usually reflect expanded coverage by our verification pipeline.

Want to verify a specific change yourself? Click the source link on the row — it points at the official government page that backs the new status.

See the methodology page for how entries are verified, and the Travel Radar hub for editorially written border-rule explainers.
